name: BlockSpec
lead: What a definition says a block *is*. Every hook takes `base` as its **last** argument: call it and you extended what is under you, leave it out and you replaced it. `base` is a decision rather than a reentrant call — its effects land when your hook returns, and calling it twice happens once.

functions.name: on_use
functions.signature: blockSpec.on_use((block: BlockAt, player: Player ?, held: string ?, base: (... any) -> any) -> Used ?) → ?
functions.description: The hooks. Writing one is what asks for it — there is no flag beside `on_random_tick` saying the random pass may land here.

functions.name: on_break
functions.signature: blockSpec.on_break((block: BlockAt, player: Player ?, by: Breaker, base: (... any) -> any) -> Drops ?) → ?
functions.description: Something broke it. Answers "none", "table" or a drops list; fails closed to the definition's `drops`.

functions.name: on_step
functions.signature: blockSpec.on_step((block: BlockAt, body: Body, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: A body is standing on it; `body` is `{ id, kind }`.

functions.name: on_tick
functions.description: A scheduled tick this block asked for came due.

functions.name: on_random_tick
functions.description: The random pass landed on it. Not the same thing as `on_tick`, which is why it has the longer name.

functions.name: on_place
functions.signature: blockSpec.on_place((block: BlockAt, player: Player ?, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: A player put it down; `block.data` is empty then, ready to be filled.

functions.name: on_neighbour
functions.signature: blockSpec.on_neighbour((block: BlockAt, from: Vec3, announced: string, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: A neighbour changed; `from` is its position and `announced` the block name the notifier announced itself as.

functions.name: on_trigger
functions.signature: blockSpec.on_trigger((block: BlockAt, cause: Trigger, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: It was lit, blasted or burnt; `cause` is "ignite", "explosion" or "fire".

functions.name: on_power
functions.signature: blockSpec.on_power((block: BlockAt, powered: boolean, base: (... any) -> any) -> ()) → ?
functions.description: A redstone signal started (`powered` is true) or stopped reaching it. Called once for each, not for every change beside it.

functions.name: on_added
functions.description: It has just been stored, whatever stored it.

functions.name: on_removed
functions.description: It has just gone from the world.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Without a namespace. The pack's own is put in front of it, and a colon here is refused: a pack cannot write another pack's name.

fields.name: looks
fields.description: A block state the client already draws, because a client has never heard of this pack. One name, or one per state in state order. `|` takes the first this version has: "crimson_planks|nether_brick".

fields.name: hardness
fields.description: Seconds-scale, as vanilla's hardness is; below zero is unbreakable.

fields.name: resistance
fields.description: What an explosion has to chew through.

fields.name: material
fields.signature: blockSpec.material: { solid: boolean ?, covers: boolean ?, firm: boolean ?, liquid: boolean ?, burns: boolean ?, }?
fields.description: The jar's Material as five questions: solid, covers (grass under it dies), firm (snow and ice need it), liquid, burns.

fields.name: opacity
fields.description: What a step through it takes off the light; 15 is an opaque cube.

fields.name: tick_every
fields.description: Seconds between `block:schedule()` and `on_tick`; 0.5 unless you say.

fields.name: drops
fields.description: What a break leaves — and, because `on_break` fails closed, what it leaves when this pack is too slow to answer. Never the looks block's. false is nothing, as "none" is.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The block in a hand. Its `id` is set to the block's name, so placing it puts this block down, and a break leaves it unless `drops` says. false is no item, also for a block with a texture.

fields.name: texture
fields.description: Its own picture on 1.21.4+: one for every state, or one per state.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Its own shape on 1.21.4+, in place of `texture`: a model that stays inside the block, one for every state or one per state. The block collides as its `looks` block does: "rail" is walked through.

fields.name: facing
fields.description: Turns its front to whoever places it; `block.facing` reads and turns it.

fields.name: power
fields.description: What it gives a redstone circuit, 0 or 15: one number for every face, a table keyed by face (the names `texture` takes), or a list of either with one entry per state. It is the power a block of redstone gives.

fields.name: label
fields.description: The name of the item a textured block comes with.

fields.name: extends
fields.description: A handle, a game block's name, a plain table of fields and hooks, or a list of those **innermost first**. There is no class and no metatable: fields merge and hooks wrap.

title: BlockSpec type
